stories.title: Harbaugh: Giants pulled recent offer for RB Taylor but 'things do change'
stories.summary: The Giants pulled a recent trade offer for Jonathan Taylor, according to coach John Harbaugh, who added that doesn't mean a deal is completely off the table.

stories.title: Giants' Nabers takes issue with Fox telecast after body-language comments
stories.summary: Malik Nabers took issue with Fox play-by-play man Joe Davis and analyst Greg Olsen for criticizing his body language during the Giants' win Sunday.

stories.title: Bears' Williams undeterred by career-high 4 INTs: 'Going to keep grippin' it, keep rippin' it'
stories.summary: Caleb Williams refused to let his four interceptions rattle his confidence as he put the Bears in position to beat the Buccaneers on a walk-off field goal.

stories.title: Brown, 19, becomes youngest PGA Tour winner since 1938 with triumph in Mexico
stories.summary: Blades Brown, 19, became the youngest PGA Tour winner in 88 years Sunday when he won the World Wide Technology Championship in a playoff.

stories.title: Hellebuyck won't play in Winnipeg; Devils cite 'reduction in our expected win probability'
stories.summary: The Devils announced Connor Hellebuyck will not face the Jets on Tuesday night in his first trip to Winnipeg since his contentious trade demand was granted.
